scientific_integrity.claim_scope: All finite fields, every triangular matrix algebra T_n with n>=3, arbitrary characteristic. Geometric codimension claims hold over arbitrary fields.
scientific_integrity.limitations: Only maximum pairing rank, its exact frequency and the complement geometry are determined; no all-ranks enumerator, no general structural matrix algebra or independent audit. Historical priority provisional.

title: Maximal associative-pairing ranks of triangular matrix algebras: an odd-even counting dichotomy
